She co-founded Med Matrix alongside Cole Siefer in July 2023 and has been instrumental in building the practice from the ground up. Carrie ensures every aesthetics patient receives the same root-cause, lab-driven approach that defines Med Matrix's functional medicine services. Services by Carrie Siefer Med Spa Services Most med spas treat the surface. We start with your labs. Hair loss, acne, and skin aging all have internal drivers: hormones, inflammation, nutrient deficiencies, gut health. We fix the root cause and treat the surface. That's why our results last. Learn more → Hair Loss Treatment in Portland, Maine Hair loss isn't just cosmetic. It's a signal. Low thyroid, hormone imbalances, nutrient deficiencies, inflammation, and stress all show up in your hair first. We test for the cause, not just the symptom, and build a protocol that addresses both. Learn more → Acne Treatment in Maine Accutane, antibiotics, topicals. You've tried them all. The acne keeps coming back because nobody addressed what's driving it. Hormones, gut health, insulin, inflammation. We test for the internal triggers and treat them directly. Learn more → Fine Lines & Wrinkles Treatment Aging skin has internal drivers that Botox can't reach. Declining hormones, oxidative stress, poor collagen synthesis, and chronic inflammation all accelerate how your skin ages. We address the biology behind the wrinkles, not just the surface.
